growth.name: NVIDIA
growth.blurb: AI GPU dominance; market cap has pushed to a record $5.57T, trading near its 52-week high of $236.54.

growth.name: Meta Platforms
growth.blurb: Up 1.1% today and roughly 11% YTD on renewed AI/ad-business momentum; market cap now $1.85T.

growth.name: Amazon.com
growth.blurb: AWS revenue surged 36.7% YoY to $42.2B in Q2 2026 — its fastest growth in 18 quarters — driving a 43% jump in operating income and a fresh post-earnings high for the stock.

growth.name: Alphabet Inc.
growth.blurb: Google Cloud revenue accelerated to 82% growth and total revenue rose 24% YoY to $119.8B in Q2 2026, the 12th straight quarter of double-digit growth even as shares dipped on a capex hike.

growth.name: Microsoft Corporation
growth.blurb: Azure cloud revenue grew 43% YoY last quarter — the fastest pace since early 2022 — pushing annual Azure revenue past $100B with CFO Amy Hood guiding toward 45% growth next quarter.

growth.name: Eli Lilly and Company
growth.blurb: Mounjaro sales nearly doubled YoY to $9.94B and Zepbound rose 46% to $4.93B, driving 48% total revenue growth in Q2 2026 and a raised full-year guidance of $82-85B.

growth.name: Shopify
growth.blurb: E-commerce infrastructure grower; Moderate Buy consensus with a $172 price target (~19% implied upside).

growth.name: Palantir Technologies
growth.blurb: Enterprise/government AI analytics; trading near its 52-week high of $207.52 with a P/E above 160.

growth.name: Dell Technologies
growth.blurb: AI server backlog remains the core growth driver; P/E 31, dividend yield 0.43%.

growth.name: Broadcom
growth.blurb: AI networking/custom-silicon leader; has historically risen in 13 straight Q4s; P/E 45, dividend yield 0.72%.

growth.name: SanDisk
growth.blurb: 2026's best-performing large-cap on AI-driven flash/HBM memory demand; still down 26% from its 52-week high even after today's gain.

growth.name: Visa Inc.
growth.blurb: Visa's fiscal Q3 adjusted EPS rose 11% YoY to $3.32 on revenue of $11.63B, beating consensus as cross-border payment volumes stayed resilient.

growth.name: Mastercard Inc.
growth.blurb: Mastercard's Q2 net revenue climbed 14% YoY to $9.3B, powered by 22% growth in value-added services even as cross-border volumes cooled amid a travel slowdown.

growth.name: Caterpillar Inc.
growth.blurb: Caterpillar posted a 31% EPS surprise last quarter on a record $72B backlog and surging AI-driven power-generation demand, with trailing-twelve-month revenue up 21.5% YoY.

growth.name: GE Aerospace
growth.blurb: GE Aerospace's Q2 adjusted revenue grew 24% YoY to $12.6B, led by 27% growth in Commercial Engines & Services, with full-year 2026 revenue now guided to grow more than 18%.

growth.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
growth.blurb: JPMorgan's latest quarterly revenue jumped 27.7% YoY to $58.02B, beating consensus by over $7B as EPS of $6.14 topped estimates on surging trading and investment-banking fees.

growth.name: Apple Inc.
growth.blurb: Apple's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 16% YoY to $109.4B on 22% iPhone growth and record $30.7B Services revenue, though guidance points to growth decelerating to 9-11% next quarter.

growth.name: Costco Wholesale
growth.blurb: Costco's total comparable sales rose 9.4% with digitally-enabled comps up 19.5% and e-commerce traffic up 30%, as net sales growth of 11.2% beat estimates in the latest quarter.

growth.name: Tesla, Inc.
growth.metric_label: Q3 2026 delivery growth (analyst consensus est., YoY)
growth.blurb: Tesla's Q3 delivery consensus of roughly 462,000 vehicles would mark its first annual delivery increase since 2023 (+8% YoY), even with the stock still down about 22% year-to-date.

growth.name: Deere & Company
growth.blurb: Deere's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 5% YoY to $12.61B, well ahead of estimates as tariff refunds and construction-equipment strength offset a soft ag cycle, prompting a raised profit outlook.

growth.name: The Boeing Company
growth.blurb: Boeing's H1 2026 revenue grew 11% YoY to $46.8B as 737 MAX deliveries rose 14% to 171 jets and backlog hit a record $715B, though shares stay volatile on recurring certification delays.

growth.name: NextEra Energy
growth.blurb: NextEra grew adjusted EPS 9.5% YoY in Q2 2026 and reaffirmed its 8%+ annual EPS growth target through 2032, with shares still near the low end of their 52-week range.

growth.name: Adobe Inc.
growth.metric_label: Annualized recurring revenue growth (Q3 FY26, YoY)
growth.blurb: Adobe's annualized recurring revenue hit $27.5B, up 11.2% YoY in fiscal Q3, with EPS of $6.13 beating estimates as Firefly and AI-assisted Creative Cloud tools gain traction.

growth.name: Applied Optoelectronics
growth.blurb: AI-datacenter optics demand story intact; up ~6% today after recent volatility. Dilution risk from a recent $600M raise remains live.

growth.name: UnitedHealth Group
growth.blurb: UnitedHealth raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $19.50-$20.00 after a strong Q2, but revenue growth has slowed to just 2% YoY as elevated medical costs keep pressuring margins.

stability.name: General Mills
stability.blurb: General Mills shares are down over 20% in 2026, pushing the yield above 7%, though its current increase streak of roughly 6 years is modest next to packaged-food peers.

stability.name: Verizon
stability.blurb: Verizon's 20th consecutive annual dividend hike in early 2026 pushed the yield near 6%, among the highest in the S&P 500, as it closes in on Dividend King status.

stability.name: Realty Income
stability.blurb: Realty Income, 'The Monthly Dividend Company,' has raised its payout for 31 consecutive years and yields 5.9%, distributed monthly rather than quarterly.

stability.name: Kimberly-Clark
stability.blurb: Kimberly-Clark has increased its dividend for 54 consecutive years, and today's 5.3% yield sits well above the consumer-staples sector average.

stability.name: United Parcel Service
stability.blurb: UPS has raised its dividend for 16 consecutive years, but a payout ratio above 120% of trailing earnings signals the pace of future hikes may need to slow.

stability.name: AT&T
stability.blurb: AT&T slashed its dividend 47% in 2022 alongside the WarnerMedia spinoff and has held it flat at $0.2775/quarter since, prioritizing debt paydown over payout growth.

stability.name: Duke Energy
stability.blurb: Duke Energy has lifted its dividend for 22 consecutive years and has paid a cash dividend for 100 straight years, the definition of regulated-utility stability.

stability.name: Southern Company
stability.blurb: Southern Company's 25th consecutive annual dividend increase in 2026 newly qualified it as an S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrat, backed by 79 straight years of steady-or-higher payouts.

stability.name: Chevron
stability.blurb: Chevron has raised its dividend for 39 straight years, a streak that held through oil crashes, the 2008 crisis, and the pandemic without a single cut or freeze.

stability.name: McDonald's
stability.blurb: Franchise-driven cash flows; yield near a 10-year high at 3.26%, above the sector median.

stability.name: Procter & Gamble
stability.blurb: Decades of dividend increases and 136 years of uninterrupted dividends; low-beta household-staples anchor.

stability.name: ExxonMobil
stability.blurb: Low-beta energy major; 43 consecutive years of dividend increases.

stability.name: Merck
stability.blurb: Merck has raised its dividend for 15 consecutive years on top of a 55-year unbroken payment history, underpinned by steady pharmaceutical cash flows.

stability.name: Colgate-Palmolive
stability.blurb: Colgate-Palmolive is a Dividend King with 64 consecutive years of increases and an unbroken dividend payment record dating back to 1895.

stability.name: Coca-Cola
stability.blurb: Global beverage staple with highly predictable cash flows; 54 consecutive years of dividend increases.

stability.name: IBM
stability.blurb: 31 years of dividend growth; enterprise AI/hybrid-cloud pivot continues to support the stock.

stability.name: Johnson & Johnson
stability.blurb: 64 consecutive years of dividend increases; healthcare defensiveness near record stock highs.

stability.name: Archer-Daniels-Midland
stability.blurb: ADM made its 377th consecutive quarterly dividend payment in 2026, marking 53 straight years of annual increases and Dividend King status in agribusiness.

stability.name: Abbott Laboratories
stability.blurb: Abbott has increased its dividend for 54 consecutive years, a Dividend Aristocrat record built on diversified revenue across devices, diagnostics, nutrition, and generics.

stability.name: Target
stability.blurb: Target extended its Dividend King streak to roughly 55 straight years in 2026, even while posting its smallest percentage dividend increase in over five decades.

stability.name: Aflac
stability.blurb: Aflac extended its dividend increase streak to roughly 44 years in 2026, a four-decade run that cements its Dividend King status in the insurance sector.

stability.name: Walmart
stability.blurb: Retail scale leader; low beta, resilient through downturns; dividend aristocrat status intact.

stability.name: 3M
stability.blurb: 3M's 64-year dividend growth streak ended with a 2024 cut tied to the Solventum spinoff, and the payout has since resumed growing for two straight years.

stability.name: Honeywell
stability.blurb: Honeywell has raised its dividend for roughly 14 consecutive years, though its 2026 aerospace-unit spin-off activity adds near-term uncertainty to the payout's path.

stability.name: PepsiCo
stability.blurb: Highest yield of the group at 4.6%; diversified snacks & beverages, 54 straight years of dividend growth.

nextgen.name: Rocket Lab
nextgen.blurb: Neutron rocket + space services; TTM revenue +45.8% YoY to $679.6M, with Q1 2026 growth of 63.5%; stock well off its 52-week high of $151 but up sharply from its $37.57 low.

nextgen.name: IonQ
nextgen.blurb: Trapped-ion quantum computing leader; 2025 revenue +202% YoY to $130M; FY26 guidance raised to $450-460M following the SkyWater deal. Strong Buy consensus, $67 average target (+53% upside).

nextgen.name: Tempus AI
nextgen.blurb: AI-driven precision medicine/diagnostics; 2026 revenue forecast at $1.60B (+25.5% YoY). Consensus Buy rating, average target $68.18.

nextgen.name: IREN Limited
nextgen.blurb: Ex-bitcoin miner pivoted to AI cloud; TTM revenue $707M (+41.1% YoY). Consensus target $81.47 implies ~85% upside, backed by a heavy 2027 capex plan of $25-30B.

nextgen.name: CrowdStrike
nextgen.blurb: CrowdStrike's trailing revenue reached $5.40B (up 24.3% YoY) with Q2 FY2027 revenue growth of 26% and $377M in free cash flow, cementing its position as the AI-native cybersecurity platform of record even as shares trade near all-time highs around $265.

nextgen.name: Cloudflare
nextgen.blurb: Cloudflare's Q2 2026 revenue jumped 36% YoY to $696.1M as the stock has rallied nearly 79% year-to-date on AI traffic monetization and enterprise expansion, positioning its network as critical infrastructure for both security and AI inference workloads.

nextgen.name: SoFi Technologies
nextgen.blurb: SoFi's Q2 2026 adjusted net revenue hit a record $1.2B (up 40%) with members up 35% to 15.8 million and adjusted EBITDA up 44% to $358M, prompting management to raise full-year 2026 adjusted net revenue guidance to $4.75-4.85B.

nextgen.name: Affirm
nextgen.blurb: Affirm's fiscal 2026 revenue grew 32% to $4.26B on GMV of $50.2B (up 37%), and operating income swung to a $417M profit from an $87.3M loss a year earlier, validating the buy-now-pay-later model's path to sustained profitability.

nextgen.name: D-Wave Quantum
nextgen.blurb: Secured a Dept. of Commerce funding agreement worth up to $100M; Strong Buy consensus, $34.65 average target (+99% upside); annealing quantum computing, pre-profit.

nextgen.name: Rigetti Computing
nextgen.blurb: Part of a wave of federal quantum-computing funding; down ~1.4% today, well off its 52-week high of $58.15.

nextgen.name: CRISPR Therapeutics
nextgen.blurb: Gene-editing therapeutics (Casgevy); lumpy revenue but Street sees upside, Buy-rated.

nextgen.name: AST SpaceMobile
nextgen.blurb: Q2 2026 revenue doubled sequentially to $31.5M on commercial and U.S. government traffic, and with $3.7B in pro forma cash plus a Piper Sandler Overweight call at a $100 target, the bull case rests on 2026 revenue guidance of $150-200M actually landing after the quarter missed estimates.

nextgen.name: Intuitive Machines
nextgen.blurb: Record Q2 2026 revenue of $206.2M came in over 4x Q2 2025 on satellite manufacturing and lunar lander work, and with NASA's IM-5 and IM-6 CLPS awards layering in and FY2026 guidance reaffirmed at $900M-$1B, analysts rate it Strong Buy with a $29.50 target versus the current $14.42.

nextgen.name: Beam Therapeutics
nextgen.blurb: Beam dosed its first patient in the global pivotal cohort of BEAM-302 for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency in July 2026 and published differentiated Phase 1/2 BEACON data for sickle-cell candidate risto-cel in NEJM, with a BLA submission possible as early as year-end 2026.

nextgen.name: UiPath
nextgen.blurb: UiPath's trailing-twelve-month revenue hit $1.67B (up 15.24% YoY) with the most recent quarter accelerating to 17.3% growth, as the company repositions its automation platform around agentic AI orchestration to reignite growth off a depressed ~$6-9B valuation range.

nextgen.name: First Solar
nextgen.blurb: First Solar grew trailing revenue 24% to $5.22B with 2026 EPS projected to climb 59.5% to $23.30, but the stock is down roughly 32% YTD on weaker utility-scale solar demand signals and tariff-policy uncertainty clouding next year's guidance.

nextgen.name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
nextgen.blurb: AI-driven drug discovery platform partnered with large pharma; still a pre-profit micro-cap. Consensus target $8.06 implies ~95% upside (Hold rating).

nextgen.name: Intellia Therapeutics
nextgen.metric_label: Patients enrolled in Phase 3 nex-z program
nextgen.blurb: Shares remain roughly 56% off their 52-week high after the FDA-lifted clinical hold on the MAGNITUDE Phase 3 trials, with over 650 ATTR-CM patients now enrolled and Regeneron-partnered nex-z enrollment targeted to complete in MAGNITUDE-2 in 2H 2026, making this a high-risk, data-readout-driven bet.

nextgen.name: Serve Robotics
nextgen.blurb: Serve's sidewalk delivery robots posted over 400% YoY revenue growth in Q2 2026 to $3.2M on a ~2,000-robot fleet (7x larger than a year ago) with recurring revenue now topping 50% of the mix, even as the stock itself is down roughly 59% over the past year on dilution and execution concerns.

nextgen.name: SoundHound AI
nextgen.blurb: SoundHound posted Q2 2026 revenue of $61.9M (up 45% YoY) after a record 52%-growth Q1, with full-year guidance of $225-260M reflecting momentum in automotive and IoT voice-AI deployments, though the stock has given back more than a third of its 2026 peak market cap.

nextgen.name: C3.ai
nextgen.blurb: C3.ai's market cap has nearly halved over the past year to roughly $1.6-1.7B as trailing revenue slipped to about $250M, a reminder that not every enterprise-AI story is compounding and that this is now a turnaround bet on new leadership and partner-channel sales rather than a growth story.

nextgen.name: Enovix
nextgen.blurb: Enovix grew first-half 2026 revenue 32% YoY to $16.6M on its fifth straight quarter of YoY growth, with smart-eyewear battery shipments ramping toward a 50,000-pack order, even as the stock sits roughly 80% below its 52-week high on slow scale-up of silicon-anode production.

nextgen.name: QuantumScape
nextgen.blurb: QuantumScape shares have fallen over 56% in 2026 after Morgan Stanley and TD Cowen slashed price targets to $8.50 and $6 respectively following a scaled-back Volkswagen/PowerCo agreement, leaving commercial solid-state cell manufacturing still targeted for as late as 2029.

nextgen.name: ChargePoint
nextgen.blurb: ChargePoint shares are up nearly 52% YTD after Q2 calendar-2026 revenue grew 17.7% YoY to $116.1M (beating estimates by over 10%) and subscription revenue climbed into double digits, a tentative inflection for a stock still classified as micro-cap after years of decline.

nextgen.name: Plug Power
nextgen.blurb: Plug Power raised full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance to 15-16% after Q1 revenue rose 22% to $163.5M on a 343% surge in electrolyzer sales, with gross margin improving 71 points YoY as management targets positive EBITDAS by Q4 2026.

shorts.name: Beyond Meat
shorts.blurb: Nearly half of Beyond Meat's float is sold short, among the highest in the market, as plant-based meat demand keeps shrinking and the company burns cash toward potential restructuring.

shorts.name: Lucid Group
shorts.blurb: Shares short nearly doubled from about 55M to 91M+ in a single month, pushing short interest toward 30%+ of float as the $4 stock battles chronic cash burn.

shorts.name: Upstart Holdings
shorts.blurb: Nearly 30% of float is sold short as bears bet the AI-lending model's loan volume can't keep pace with its stretched valuation despite the recent rally to $66.57.

shorts.name: Hertz Global Holdings
shorts.blurb: Shares near $1.77 carry roughly 28.6% short interest as fleet depreciation costs and EV residual-value writedowns continue to pressure the rental-car turnaround.

shorts.name: Kohl's
shorts.blurb: Structural department-store decline continues; roughly 28% of the float remains sold short.

shorts.name: indie Semiconductor
shorts.blurb: Automotive chip demand and cash-burn concerns; ~27% of shares outstanding sold short despite a Buy-rated consensus.

shorts.name: fuboTV
shorts.blurb: Shares sit at $9.09 with about 21.3% of float short as bears question subscriber growth durability now that fuboTV has folded its sports-first strategy into the Disney/Hulu Live tie-up.

shorts.name: TransMedics Group
shorts.blurb: Organ-transport technology; short interest has eased to ~21% of float as shares have continued climbing.

shorts.name: Wayfair
shorts.blurb: Online furniture retailer still working toward sustained profitability; roughly 19% of float sold short as bears bet the recent rally outruns the turnaround.

shorts.name: The Campbell's Company
shorts.blurb: Weak guidance and portfolio pressures persist; short interest ~18.8% of float, though down 10% from the prior period. Dividend yield 4.92%.

shorts.name: Sirius XM Holdings
shorts.blurb: Satellite radio subscriber growth has stalled; short interest has climbed roughly 16% of float amid streaming competition and a complex Liberty Media spinoff structure.

shorts.name: Paramount Skydance
shorts.blurb: About 15.7% of float is sold short on the newly merged studio as investors weigh integration costs and legacy linear-TV decline against its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition ambitions.

shorts.name: Super Micro Computer
shorts.blurb: Prior accounting controversy still lingers; short interest sits near 15.6% of shares with days-to-cover around 2.8.

shorts.name: Rivian Automotive
shorts.blurb: Shares sit near $14.63 with roughly 15.5% of float sold short as the EV maker still burns cash ahead of its lower-cost R2 ramp.

shorts.name: Riot Platforms
shorts.blurb: Shares fell nearly 4% to $20.53 with about 14.8% of float short, as bears target the bitcoin miner's exposure to swings in crypto prices and network hash-rate economics.

shorts.name: Peloton Interactive
shorts.blurb: Shares near $4.79 carry about 14.7% short interest as subscriber churn and discretionary spending pullback keep pressure on the connected-fitness turnaround story.

shorts.name: lululemon athletica
shorts.blurb: Short interest has climbed to ~14% of free float as bears keep building positions amid lingering guidance concerns.

shorts.name: Carvana
shorts.blurb: Shares dropped 7% to $60.47 on the latest print, with short interest running near 13.8% of float on concerns over loan-loss reserves and subprime auto credit exposure.

shorts.name: OSI Systems
shorts.blurb: Bears have added to positions ahead of earnings; security & healthcare imaging stock now carries the group's highest short interest.

shorts.name: Joby Aviation
shorts.blurb: With about $200 million in quarterly cash burn and no commercial revenue yet, roughly 11.9% of Joby's float is sold short against the pre-certification eVTOL story.

shorts.name: GameStop
shorts.blurb: Short interest has fallen roughly 44% year-over-year to about 8.4% of float, suggesting bears have largely moved on from this former meme-stock despite a declining physical-retail core.

shorts.name: Trump Media & Technology Group
shorts.blurb: Short interest of roughly 8.3% of float has crept back up as traders target the stock's history of sharp, news-driven swings disconnected from Truth Social's underlying ad revenue.

shorts.name: Under Armour
shorts.blurb: Turnaround skepticism has eased; short interest has fallen sharply to ~8% of float (from ~28% previously) as shares rallied off 52-week lows.

shorts.name: AMC Entertainment Holdings
shorts.blurb: Shares slid over 5% to roughly $2.85 after fresh debt pricing added to an already leveraged balance sheet, even as short interest sits modest at about 5.2% of float.

shorts.name: Warner Bros. Discovery
shorts.blurb: Short interest is low at roughly 2.5% of float since the stock is now effectively trading on deal terms, with the pending Paramount Skydance acquisition set to close October 6, 2026.
